title: Siltvelt
overview: Naofumi stops at Siltvelt on his journey to Q'ten Lo. The people there worship him as a king.

title: Official Welcome
overview: Naofumi and Raph-chan stay in the castle while the rest of the party tours the town.

title: A True People
overview: The Schiltwelt Castle is shaken by a poisoned breakfast room disturbance. Atra, who is incensed by the ugly war of words between the various factions, tries to blackmail the heavy hitters and speak highly of Shobun's greatness. Shobun then discovers the real culprit through a “secret spy.”

title: Entrusted Power
overview: Fohl battles the cunning and sneaky Jaralis while Atla challenges the veteran warrior Lyceras.

title: White Tiger
overview: When Fohl is about to be defeated, Naofumi asks him if he has the resolve to become stronger.

title: Leaving Port
overview: Naofumi returns, temporarily, to Lurolona Village, and decides who he’s going to take with him.

title: Arriving in Q'ten Lo
overview: In Q’ten Lo, the party finds that it’s forbidden to kill an animal, and that the people are heavily taxed.

title: Orochi
overview: The Emperor’s blessing causes the “Sealed Orochi” to revive.

title: Zodia
overview: A lost girl named "Zodia" appears as Muramasa suggests a drinking party.

title: Prayers
overview: Raphtalia goes to meet the shrine maiden of the water dragon, Shildina.

title: Oracle Miko
overview: Shildina appears at the old capital and asks for a duel between representatives of both sides.

title: Return of the Emperor
overview: The emperor challenges Raphtalia to a one-on-one duel!
